data.name: 鸚鵡團 AuditionsGo
data.detailed_description:
Rhythm, style, and interaction come together on one stage

AuditionsGo combines rhythm gameplay, character customization, and AI interaction into one music and dance experience.

You can improve your skills through precise rhythm challenges, customize your character freely, design stage performances, and build ongoing relationships with AI-powered virtual idols.

Whether you seek high-level gameplay or creative expression, there's always a place for you here.

Focus on rhythm and push your limits

The core gameplay centers on the rhythm game experience:

  • Tap in sync with the beat to achieve perfect timing and combos

  • Multiple note types and judgment systems

  • Songs across multiple difficulty levels to match your current skill

  • Audition Mode + Rhythm Mode — two modes, double the fun

  • Combo, scoring, and feedback systems provide continuous challenges

  • Customize rhythm maps and design rhythm levels

From beginner to advanced, keep pushing your limits.

Freely customize outfits and define your stage style

More than gameplay, it's self-expression:

  • Support both realistic and anime visuals

  • Highly customizable character creation

  • Mix and match a wide variety of outfits

  • Supports custom outfit design

  • Switch freely between stage looks and daily styles

Create your visual identity, build your idol group, and bring your aesthetic to the stage.

A light social experience for sharing and connecting

Build connections beyond rhythm:

  • Showcase your characters and stage creations

  • Explore and experience creations from other players

  • Share rhythm maps, outfits, and performance

  • Join community interactions and challenges

  • Play solo or enjoy the rhythm with friends

From personal expression to social interaction.

You can choose between two paths: creator or player

In addition to official content, you can also:

  • Share your creations and earn likes and support from other players

  • Comtinue exploring contents generated by community

  • Compete on leaderboards and achieve higher scores

  • Discover diverse playstyles and creative ideas

  • Get inspired in an ever-growing creator community

Here, you are both a player and a creator.

data.short_description: AuditionsGo is an AI-driven music and dance game. Follow the beat, hit the notes, and challenge your limits in timing and precision. From gameplay to creation, everything is in your hands.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (22H2 or later) / Windows 11 64-bit (23H2 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-6300 (4-core / 2-core 4-thread, 2.8GHz+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti (2GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 560 (2GB VRAM) / Intel Arc A310
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (22H2 or later) / Windows 11 64-bit (23H2 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600 (6-core, 3.0GHz+)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB VRAM) / Intel Arc A580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
